description: Verse fixes a broken automation: paste the error (Zapier, Make, n8n, Power Automate, GitHub Actions or code) and get what it means and the steps to fix it. One call, one fix. Costs 0.05 USDC on Base (eip155:8453) per call, paid with x402 over MCP: call it without payment to get the PaymentRequired terms in structuredContent, then call it again with the signed PaymentPayload in params._meta["x402/payment"]. The settlement comes back in result._meta["x402/payment-response"]. A call that cannot be done (bad input, the service busy) is never charged. The same service over HTTP: POST https://a-to-mind.com/api/x402/fix.

details.description: the error message or log, optional

name: paid_fix
title: Fix a broken automation (0.05 USDC, x402)
